descriptionChirho: Qal: to wall someone in or block their way as an act of restriction or confinement; used of God hedging a person in (Job 19:8, Lam 3:7, 3:9). Arabic sayyaja, Swahili -zuia/-jengea ukuta.
Qal: to construct or erect a wall; includes the substantival participle 'wall-builder, mason' as a trade designation (2 Kgs 12:13, 22:6; Mic 7:11). Arabic bana, Swahili -jenga.
Qal: to close up or repair a gap/breach in a wall; used of restoring broken-down walls and standing in the gap (Isa 58:12, Ezek 13:5, 22:30). Arabic sadda, Swahili -karabati/-ziba.
